title: User management
description: Manage user identities, group access, concurrency and balances.
usernameHelp: Use 2–32 characters, starting with a letter; letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens are allowed.
concurrencyHelp: Maximum concurrent requests for this user. 0 = unlimited.
rpmHelp: Maximum requests per minute shared across all API keys for this user. 0 = unlimited; the current group's RPM limit also applies.
deleteHelp: The user's sessions and keys will be invalidated. Past transactions and usage records are retained.
grantHelp: Select the groups this user can access. A user-specific multiplier overrides the group default; blank inherits the default and 0 means free. Blank user-specific RPM inherits the group limit; 0 removes this layer's limit. The user's total RPM limit still applies.
noGroups: No groups yet. Create one on the Groups page first.
selectedGroups: {{count}} groups selected. With none selected, the user has no group access through these grants; valid subscriptions still grant their own entitlements.
selectedGroups_one: {{count}} group selected. With none selected, the user has no group access through these grants; valid subscriptions still grant their own entitlements.
selectedGroups_other: {{count}} groups selected. With none selected, the user has no group access through these grants; valid subscriptions still grant their own entitlements.
groupsFailed: Groups could not be loaded. User access cannot be edited: {{message}}
sharedWalletHelp: Administrators in this domain share this balance. Funding any administrator credits the same wallet.
